title: Files
summary: Find, inspect, enrich, safely transform durable uploads, and materialize schema-validated canonical JSON Lines artifacts.

create.reason: Ordinary user files enter through uploads. Specialized artifact workflows, including schema-validated JSON Lines materialization, are not the general files.file lifecycle create operation.

read.note: The compatibility file_id input remains accepted; new metadata reads use the bounded file_ids array, including one-file reads.

update.note: The compatibility singleton input remains accepted; new multi-file enrichment uses the bounded atomic updates array.

delete.reason: Stored file bytes and provenance are immutable evidence; no destructive file deletion operation is exposed to the agent.

resources.title: Activity file attachment
resources.summary: An ordered role-qualified file attached to an immutable activity event.
resources.reason: The activity ledger owns immutable request and result provenance attachments.
